defects: Adds the extra instance hypothesis [I.IsMaximal], which is not present in the gold statement (gold only requires p.IsMaximal, P.IsMaximal, P.LiesOver p, I.LiesOver P). I.LiesOver P does not imply I.IsMaximal in general commutative rings (e.g. T = S[x], I = P·S[x] lies over P but is not maximal), so this restricts the theorem to a proper subclass of cases covered by the gold.

Uses the pre-existing Mathlib declaration Ideal.inertiaDeg (via dot notation X.inertiaDeg Y) rather than the gold's newly introduced inertiaDeg'; it is not established that these coincide in the generality (non-maximal I) that the gold's inertiaDeg' is presumably designed to handle, so the produced statement may express a different, more restrictive proposition even apart from the added hypothesis.
